sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a woven exhibition that seeks to spotlight uncredited labour by women is among the projects from EMMA Creative Centre Pforzheim. Also featured are knitted garments informed by the milling history of Kouvola, Finland, and artworks exploring a sustainable future. EMMA Creative Centre Pforzheim Course: Designers in Residence 2026 Tutors: Melitta Baumeister, Almut Benkert, The post Exhibition highlighting women's uncredited work among projects from EMMA Creative Centre Pforzheim appeared first on Dezeen .
